spans.title: First Snow
spans.blurb: A boy of twelve, newly arrived in England, finds the ship's deck white overnight and runs to tell the mate that someone has thrown salt everywhere.

spans.title: Struck Upon the Rocks
spans.blurb: A sailor dreams of shipwreck three nights running, then spots the rock himself. When the sloop strikes, the captain gives an order that could doom everyone below deck.

spans.title: Opening the Shutters
spans.blurb: A woman wakes in a castle bedroom in Italy, throws open the shutters, and finds more beauty waiting than she knows how to hold.

spans.title: Arrival by Lantern Light
spans.blurb: Two Englishwomen, stranded at night in Italy with no Italian, must follow a stranger with a lantern down steps and along a dark quay toward a castle they cannot see.

books.pairNote: Consecutive scenes in the book, the night walk then the next morning, but each carries its own payoff.

spans.title: His Grandfather's Bed
spans.blurb: A small, immaculate man travels far to sleep in his grandfather's bed, and sits down to supper among four giant sons who dwarf everyone but his talk.

spans.title: Bound by Tiny Hands
spans.blurb: A traveller wakes flat on his back, arms, legs, and hair pinned to the ground, as something alive and six inches tall marches up his chest.

spans.title: The Snow Child
spans.blurb: A merchant comes home after ten years abroad to find a young son, and his wife has a perfectly calm explanation involving a leaf of sorrel and snow.

spans.title: Dead Drunk
spans.blurb: A drunk Dutchman corners a priest, demands confession at knifepoint, receives absolution, and then decides the sensible next step is to die at once and go straight to heaven.

spans.title: The Sea Below the World
spans.blurb: Deep underground, a traveller opens his dazzled eyes on something impossible: a limitless sea breaking on golden sand beneath a roof of rock.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the discovery of the vast underground sea, one of the book's central wonders.
spans.brokenNote: The last sentence breaks off unfinished ('the mighty rocks faded away like'), so the ending is visibly truncated.

spans.title: A Battle of Monsters
spans.blurb: On a raft far from any shore, three travellers are jolted awake as two enormous creatures from a vanished age circle their vessel and then turn on each other.
spans.spoilerNote: Gives away the famous prehistoric sea monster battle and which creature wins.

spans.title: The Man Under the Straw
spans.blurb: Alone on a prairie homestead, a woman is handed a rifle by a Mounted Policeman and told to shoot anyone who breaks cover while he searches her farm.

spans.title: The Faded Rose
spans.blurb: A rich creditor lays a pressed rose before the daughter of the ruined judge and confesses the strange, patient obsession behind every loan he made.
spans.spoilerNote: Reveals the creditor's long secret love and his offer of marriage, the early turning point that sets the novel in motion.

spans.title: Meeting the Dragon
spans.blurb: At a Paris station, a girl with a red rose watches for the ogre she has agreed to meet under a borrowed name. He is nothing like she pictured.

spans.title: The Last Lunarians
spans.blurb: A ship of explorers sinks into a lightless crater on the moon and finds stagnant water, grey moss, and something that was once, perhaps, human.
